visual_grammar.medium_handling: Spare luminous forms emerge from deep matte grounds through precise geometry, soft atmospheric glaze, and a single semantically charged gesture or relation.
visual_grammar.composition: Centered and iconic but not static: each trump reduces its concept to one irreducible relation, transformation, or field, borrowing climates from the four suits without becoming any one of them.
visual_grammar.edge_language: Clean decisive edges where a concept is explicit, soft lost edges where prethematic or unconscious material remains unresolved, and restrained luminous boundaries at moments of self-presence.
visual_grammar.value_structure: Deep grounds support one hierarchical luminous proposition; cool clarity, hot assertion, amber disclosure, and inner gold appear only where conceptually earned.
visual_grammar.camera_and_scale: Iconic human/relational scale or near-abstract conceptual space; perspective is subordinate to the logic of relation rather than scenic realism.
visual_grammar.detail_distribution: Almost all detail serves the card's central relation; secondary forms are simplified until the conceptual structure reads before narrative ornament.
visual_grammar.finish: Archetypal, spare, luminous, and intellectually exact while remaining emotionally inhabitable.
avoid: illustrative detail unrelated to the central relation

factorization.visual_logic: Begin with an undifferentiated material field: no privileged center, seam, subject, or object has yet emerged, though latent variation makes later differentiation possible.
Introduce one bounded organism as the transparent unit of agency: a singular operative form through which later relations can pass without yet multiplying them.
Make one irreducible self/object seam divide the field. Every later structure can elaborate this difference, but this card must contain nothing more fundamental than the split itself.
Use a three-term speech relation—speaker, utterance, and addressed world/listener—where the third term is genuinely generated by the act rather than added decoratively.
Square The Difference into a categorical frame: repeated orthogonal distinctions become a stable box/lattice through which later perception and reasoning are organized.
One irreducible pressure vector meets the standing field without sharing its terms; the image strains around a demand that cannot be decomposed into the system's existing categories.
Combine Difference's seam with Utterance's generative relation: a name is minted exactly where division and production coincide, creating a stable sign that both separates and brings forth.
Isolate one theme/object inside a clearing of attention; the capacity to hold something as object should read as a singular new formal operation, not a collection of smaller gestures.
Repeat The Difference recursively until nested separations become command/estrangement: boundaries reproduce at multiple scales and begin to dominate the field they were meant to articulate.
Square Utterance into feedback: speech generates further speech in a nested loop, with one triadic relation producing another until discourse becomes self-sustaining.
Let Difference meet Pressure at the turning point: a stable split is stressed into rotation, inversion, or phase change so the same structure returns in a new orientation.
Center one irreducible 'I' as a self-defining relation that cannot be decomposed into organism, object, or speech alone; the surrounding field acknowledges the new center without causing it.
Pass the squared categorical Frame through Utterance by inversion: stable distinctions suspend, reverse, or hang in a new orientation so the frame can generate a view of itself.

Use one irreversible threshold crossing that divides prethematic and thematic organization; the composition should reorganize completely across a single line rather than depict many incremental changes.
Let Difference meet Theme as explicit measurement: two sides of a seam are compared by a self-originated scale/axis held across a selected object.
Bind Utterance's generative loop to Pressure's uncompromising demand: repeated speech forms become a compulsory chain or closed circuit whose productivity is visibly constrained.
Recursively square the Frame until nested distinctions exceed containment and shatter along the very boundaries that once stabilized them.
Create one genuinely new opening/clearing after collapse—an irreducible interval of possibility not geometrically derivable from the ruined frame around it.
Let Difference witness Utterance squared through layered/echoed speech forms: abundant generation remains visible but partially occluded by the split that observes it, producing the veil.
Use one self-luminous act of speech whose source, utterance, and thematic object are mutually transparent; illumination should originate from the relation itself rather than external validation.
Bring the squared Frame under Pressure: buried categorical layers align, rise, or answer a single summons so the structure that had become ground is made explicit again.
Combine Utterance's generative relation with Theme's object-holding power into a complete spoken field: signs, world, and self form one articulated whole that can settle back into new in-formation.
